shortDescription: This module will manage a user entities in a SAP S4/HANA environment

options.name: client
options.description: The client number to connect to. You must quote the value to ensure retaining the leading zeros.

options.name: company
options.description: The specific company the user belongs to. The company name must be available in the SAP system.

options.name: conn_password
options.description: The required password for the SAP system.

options.name: conn_username
options.description: The required username for the SAP system.

options.name: email
options.description: The email address of the user in the SAP system.

options.name: firstname
options.description: The Firstname of the user in the SAP system.

options.name: force
options.description: Must be C('True') if the password or type should be overwritten.

options.name: host
options.description: The required host for the SAP system. Can be either an FQDN or IP Address.

options.name: lastname
options.description: The lastname of the user in the SAP system.

options.name: password
options.description: The password for the user in the SAP system.

options.name: profiles
options.description: Assign profiles to the user. Should be in uppercase, for example C('SAP_NEW') or C('SAP_ALL').

options.name: state
options.description: The decision what to do with the user.

options.name: sysnr
options.description: The system number of the SAP system. You must quote the value to ensure retaining the leading zeros.

options.name: user_type
options.description: The type for the user in the SAP system. C('A') Dialog user, C('B') System User, C('C') Communication User, C('S') Service User, C('L') Reference User. Must be in uppercase.

options.name: useralias
options.description: The alias for the user in the SAP system.
